lesson: A repair-dev selector may prefer a later checkpoint for small margin gains even when an earlier checkpoint already reaches the same perfect task accuracy and retains more parent capability. Final ratification should use untouched frozen evidence and prefer the earliest checkpoint that clears all capability and retention gates.
process_rule: Do not reward extra training solely for confidence or margin inflation after capability saturation. Use frozen generalization evidence and retention floors. Experiment step limits are not architecture ceilings.
